docetaxel.source_basis: Current regimen-specific NCCP source and retrieved EMA/HPRA SmPC; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending.

risks.label: Neutropenia / febrile neutropenia
risks.detail: Severe neutropenia and infection can occur.

risks.label: Fluid retention / oedema
risks.detail: Fluid retention, swelling or effusions can develop.

risks.label: Nail and skin changes
risks.detail: Nail discolouration/loss and skin reactions can occur.

risks.label: Infusion hypersensitivity
risks.detail: Infusion reactions can occur and may be severe.

risks.label: Lung inflammation / breathing problems
risks.detail: New cough or breathlessness may need urgent assessment; serious lung injury can occur.

risks.label: Serious bowel inflammation
risks.detail: Severe abdominal pain, persistent diarrhoea or fever may indicate a serious bowel complication and need urgent assessment.

risks.label: Vision changes
risks.detail: New visual symptoms require prompt review; treatment-related eye problems can occur.

paclitaxel.source_basis: Current regimen-specific NCCP source and retrieved EMA/HPRA SmPC; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending.

risks.label: Peripheral neuropathy
risks.detail: Numbness, tingling or pain in the hands or feet can occur and may persist.

risks.label: Infusion hypersensitivity
risks.detail: Infusion reactions can occur despite premedication and can rarely be severe.

risks.label: Hair loss
risks.detail: Hair loss is common with paclitaxel.

risks.label: Myelosuppression
risks.detail: Neutropenia and other cytopenias can occur.

risks.label: Lung inflammation / breathing problems
risks.detail: New cough or breathlessness may need urgent assessment; serious lung injury can occur.

risks.label: Serious bowel inflammation
risks.detail: Severe abdominal pain, persistent diarrhoea or fever may indicate a serious bowel complication and need urgent assessment.

risks.label: Vision changes
risks.detail: New visual symptoms require prompt review; treatment-related eye problems can occur.

risks.label: Cardiac rhythm / conduction problems
risks.detail: Fainting, chest pain or palpitations need urgent review. Significant conduction problems may need monitoring during later treatment.
